mapper.select: UPDATE task_queue SET status = 'RUNNING', owner_instance = #{ownerInstance}, next_run_at = now() WHERE id = ( SELECT id FROM task_queue WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_run_at <= now() AND is_deleted = false ORDER BY priority, next_run_at, id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) RETURNING id, task_type, payload, status, priority, retry_count, max_retry, next_run_at, owner_instance, last_error, created_by, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE task_queue SET update_time = now() WHERE owner_instance = #{ownerInstance} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE task_queue SET status = 'PENDING', owner_instance = NULL, last_error = 'orphan requeue: no heartbeat within timeout' WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND is_deleted = false AND update_time < now() - make_interval(secs => #{timeoutSeconds})
UPDATE task_queue SET status = 'SUCCESS', last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE task_queue SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, owner_instance = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND is_deleted = false
UPDATE task_queue SET status = 'DEAD', retry_count = #{retryCount}, last_error = #{lastError}, owner_instance = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND is_deleted = false
UPDATE task_queue SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, next_run_at = now(), owner_instance = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('DEAD', 'FAILED') AND is_deleted = false
UPDATE task_queue SET status = 'DEAD', owner_instance = NULL, last_error = 'terminated by admin' WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND is_deleted = false
